title: Shuvee Etrata doesn't mind if other ‘PBB’ housemates fall for Anthony Constantino
summary: Shuvee Etrata is leaving it up to her suitor, Anthony Constantino, to handle the situation should other housemates develop feelings for him during his stint on “Pinoy Big Brother: Celebrity Collab…

blocks.text: Shuvee Etrata is leaving it up to her suitor, Anthony Constantino, to handle the situation should other housemates develop feelings for him during his stint on “Pinoy Big Brother: Celebrity Collab Edition 3.0.” During the premiere of her latest film “Red Crown,” select media asked Etrata if she would get jealous if other housemates fell for Constantino. “Ang sa akin naman, na kay Anthony na ’yan kung may magkagusto sa kanya. Talaga namang kagusto-gusto naman po talaga si Anthony, the best, highly recommended,” she said.
